en: Multi-view color postcard showing five Bucharest scenes. Top: the Arcul de Triumf. Left middle: Aleea Trandafirilor in Herăstrău Park, with rose beds. Right middle: the Dr. M. Minovici Folk Art Museum, a white Neo-Romanian house by a broad boulevard. Bottom left: Piața Națiunilor Unite with a fountain and surrounding buildings. Bottom right: the courtyard of Hanul lui Manuc filled with café umbrellas. The front bears the word "Bucuresti." The reverse has Romanian postal layout and a bilingual caption listing the views.
